block.bathhouse.steel_firebox.tooltip: Stove core. Even heat, quick to start.
block.bathhouse.cast_iron_firebox.toolti: Stove core. The hottest, but dries the air.
block.bathhouse.brick_firebox.tooltip: Core of a massive stove: slow to heat, holds heat even longer.
block.bathhouse.heating_element.tooltip: Electric stove core: runs on redstone, smokeless, needs no ash pit or chimney.
block.bathhouse.ash_pit.tooltip: Under the firebox: grate and ash drawer. Gives the draft. A full ash pit (right-click to empty) chokes the fire.
block.bathhouse.closed_heater.tooltip: On the firebox: stones inside the stove, in the flame. Very hot: light steam, soft heat. The heart of a steam lodge.
block.bathhouse.open_heater.tooltip: On the firebox: an open stone basket. Heats the room fast: for the ember room.
block.bathhouse.boiler.tooltip: On the firebox: fill with water and it steams a mist hall.
block.bathhouse.water_tank.tooltip: In the flue: heats water with the hot gases. Hot water from the ladle makes light steam and never cracks stones.
block.bathhouse.damper.tooltip: In the flue. Right-click to open/close. Closed after the fire is out it keeps the heat; closed while burning: smoke!
block.bathhouse.fuel_tunnel.tooltip: In front of the firebox door, through the wall: stoke from the changing room, no smoke in the steam room.
block.bathhouse.stove_cladding.tooltip: Beside the firebox or heater: more heat capacity, softer heat.
block.bathhouse.chimney.tooltip: Top of the stove. On the stove: heated white; in the ceiling for a stove without its own flue: gray.
block.bathhouse.steam_generator.tooltip: Fill with water and give it redstone: makes steam. The basis of a mist hall.
block.bathhouse.warm_lounger.tooltip: Heated marble (redstone). In a mist hall sessions go twice as fast on it.
block.bathhouse.bath_gauge.tooltip: Hang it in a closed steam room: it decides the bath type, the steam level and grants the buffs.
block.bathhouse.bath_gauge.tooltip2: Right-click for a report. Comparators read the temperature.
block.bathhouse.smoke_vent.tooltip: Right-click to open or close. Open, it lets out smoke, steam and some heat.
block.bathhouse.plunge_wall_wood.tooltip: Wall or floor of a plunge: oak with steel hoops.
block.bathhouse.plunge_wall_composite.to: Polymer liner clad in wood: keeps the heat best.
block.bathhouse.plunge_wall_tile.tooltip: Concrete with tiles and mosaic: a stationary basin, keeps the cold, loses heat.
block.bathhouse.plunge_bench.tooltip: Inner bench: sitting on it the water reaches your chest. Required in a hot plunge.
block.bathhouse.plunge_stove.tooltip: Wood stove: in the wall (outside) it heats through one face, inside the basin (built-in) through every face.
block.bathhouse.plunge_chiller.tooltip: Powered by redstone, cools a cold plunge even in hot lands.
block.bathhouse.plunge_thermometer.toolt: Goes into the plunge wall at rim height: finds the basin, keeps the temperature, right-click for a report.
Ice or snow on the thermometer chills the water; a flower steeps herbs.
block.bathhouse.sawdust.tooltip: Cedar and linden shavings: the medium of a sawdust plunge. You sink into them.
item.bathhouse.ladle.tooltip: Scoop water from a source, cauldron or stove tank; right-click a heater to make steam.
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.tooltip: Whisking in a steam lodge: speeds up the session, heals, counts for the ritual (3 times). Dries out and scalds in an ember room.
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.not_here: Use the broom in a ready steam lodge
item.bathhouse.bath_broom.forbidden: The broom crumbled in the dry heat and scalded your skin!
item.bathhouse.scrub_mitt.tooltip: Scrubbing in a mist hall: speeds up the session, heals, counts for the ritual (2 times).
item.bathhouse.scrub_mitt.not_here: Use the mitt in a ready mist hall
bathhouse.penalty: Failed steaming: the %s went wrong. Received: %s
bathhouse.report.fail_warning: ⚠ The room is hot but the bath is wrong: after %s s here you get the %s weaknesses (%s), half as strong and as long as its buff
bathhouse.variant.white.hint: every firebox has its own chimney, walls stay clean
bathhouse.variant.gray.hint: the stove has no flue of its own; smoke passes through the room into a ceiling flue; heats fast
bathhouse.variant.black.hint: smoke leaves only through the door and smoke window; steam once the fire is out and the room aired
bathhouse.equipment.steam_source: steam generator or a stove with a boiler
bathhouse.equipment.closed_heater_stove: wood stove with an inner heater
bathhouse.equipment.open_heater_stove: stove with an outer heater (wood or electric)
bathhouse.criterion.canon.steam: massive stove (brick or cladding) with an inner heater and ash pit
bathhouse.criterion.canon.ember: outer heater on an electric element or a firebox with an ash pit
bathhouse.problem.duplicate: This steam room already has another thermo-hygrometer
bathhouse.problem.leaky: The room is not closed (open door, trapdoor or gate) or holds more than %s blocks of air
bathhouse.problem.too_small: Too cramped: %s m³, needs at least %s m³
bathhouse.problem.smoke: Smoke %s%%: a bath heated %s needs %s%% or less; let the fire burn out and air the room
bathhouse.tooltip.stove_core: The stove is built around the firebox: ash pit below, heater or boiler on top, chimney above.
bathhouse.tooltip.slot.flue: Goes: in the flue (above the heater or firebox)
bathhouse.tooltip.slot.front: Goes: in front of the firebox door
bathhouse.tooltip.slot.side: Goes: beside the firebox or heater
bathhouse.appliance.stones_cold: The stones are cold (%s °C); the water just runs off
bathhouse.stove.no_firebox: This part is not on a stove: it needs a firebox
bathhouse.stove.no_stones: The heater is empty: load stones (basalt, blackstone, tuff, deepslate…)
bathhouse.stove.stone_cracked: A poor stone cracked under the water
bathhouse.report.no_room: No closed steam room: shut the doors and trapdoors; it may hold at most %s blocks of air.
bathhouse.report.no_appliances: No stove or appliance borders the steam room
bathhouse.report.session_hint.steam: Steaming quality: steady %s–%s °C and %s–%s%%, broom ×3, no breaks.
bathhouse.report.session_hint.ember: Steaming quality: steady %s–%s °C and %s–%s%%, throw water ×2, no breaks.
bathhouse.report.session_hint.mist: Steaming quality: steady %s–%s °C and %s–%s%%, mitt ×2 or lounger, no breaks.
bathhouse.report.stay: Stay %s s. Steam levels grant, cumulatively: %s
bathhouse.plunge.problem.no_basin: No basin: put the thermometer into the plunge wall at rim height
bathhouse.plunge.problem.too_big: The basin is larger than %s blocks
bathhouse.plunge.problem.empty: The basin is empty: pour in water or add sawdust
bathhouse.plunge.problem.half_empty: Filled %s of %s: needs at least half
bathhouse.plunge.problem.no_bench: A hot plunge needs a bench
bathhouse.plunge.report.basin: Basin: %s blocks · water %s · sawdust %s · benches %s · stoves %s · chillers %s · insulated %s%%
bathhouse.plunge.report.rules.cold: After a steam lodge or ember room; %3$s–%4$s s; no running jumps, keep your head up. Best at %1$s–%2$s °C.
bathhouse.plunge.report.rules.hot: Sit on the bench (water no higher than the chest), keep your head up; %5$s s. Best at %1$s–%2$s °C.
bathhouse.plunge.report.rules.sawdust: Shavings no higher than the chest; %5$s s. Best at %1$s–%2$s °C.
bathhouse.plunge.cold_shock: Cold shock! Only take the cold plunge after a steam lodge or ember room.
bathhouse.plunge.abrupt: Abrupt plunge! Don't run and jump into the plunge.
bathhouse.plunge.head_under: Don't duck your head under icy water!
bathhouse.plunge.chilled: Too long in icy water: you're getting chilled!
bathhouse.plunge.overload: Your heart is overloaded: time to get out!
bathhouse.plunge.too_deep_water: Water above the chest: sit on the bench
bathhouse.plunge.too_deep_sawdust: Shavings above the chest: rake some out
bathhouse.plunge.ducking: Don't duck under: sit up straight
bathhouse.plunge.too_hot: too hot; wait or add ice
bathhouse.plunge.contrast.not_warm: No contrast without warming up in the steam room first.
bathhouse.plunge.contrast.too_short: A %s s dip is too short for contrast.
death.attack.bathhouse.overheat.player: %1$s overheated in the bathhouse while fleeing %2$s
